card.name: Scattered words inside dosing instructions
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on scattered words such as 'the' after 'from', 'information' after 'diagnostic', or the end of a brand or drug name, mostly in label instructions.

modes.label: Ends of brand or drug names
modes.description: The last piece of a capitalized brand name or enzyme name, just before the next word.

modes.label: Small words in instructions
modes.description: A short linking word in an instruction, such as 'the', 'up' or 'to'.
modes.example: Consume only clear liquids (no solid food) from<< the>> start of Monobasic Sodium Phosphate

card.writes: It lowers the odds of words like 'consists' and 'includes', so it holds back list-introducing verbs.
card.plain: It fires on assorted small words and name endings in label text, with no tidy theme.
